title: Money and finance
focus: 存款 贷款 利息 投资 股票 预算 税 房贷 保险 退休金 报销 账单 收入 支出 省钱 浪费 划算 涨价 打折 信用卡 分期 欠
body:
# Money and finance

Shopping words like 便宜 and 贵 come from childhood. Adult money talk is about banks, loans, bills, tax and whether something is worth it. These words come up when you rent a flat, claim expenses, or talk about prices and the economy.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 存款 | cúnkuǎn | savings (money in the bank) |
| 贷款 | dàikuǎn | loan / to take out a loan |
| 利息 | lìxī | interest (on money) |
| 投资 | tóuzī | to invest / investment |
| 股票 | gǔpiào | stocks / shares |
| 预算 | yùsuàn | budget |
| 税 | shuì | tax |
| 房贷 | fángdài | mortgage (home loan) |
| 保险 | bǎoxiǎn | insurance |
| 退休金 | tuìxiūjīn | pension (retirement income) |
| 报销 | bàoxiāo | to get reimbursed / claim expenses |
| 账单 | zhàngdān | bill (to pay) |
| 收入 | shōurù | income |
| 支出 | zhīchū | expenditure / outgoings (formal) |
| 开销 | kāixiāo | living expenses / spending (spoken) |
| 省钱 | shěngqián | to save money (by spending less) |
| 浪费 | làngfèi | to waste (money, time, food) |
| 划算 | huásuàn | worth it / good value |
| 涨价 | zhǎngjià | to go up in price |
| 打折 | dǎzhé | to give a discount / be on sale |
| 信用卡 | xìnyòngkǎ | credit card |
| 分期 | fēnqī | to pay in installments |
| 欠 | qiàn | to owe (money) |
| 理财 | lǐcái | to manage one's money / personal finance |
| 汇率 | huìlǜ | exchange rate |
| 转账 | zhuǎnzhàng | to transfer money (bank or app) |
| 押金 | yājīn | deposit (for a rental, refundable) |
| 通货膨胀 | tōnghuò péngzhàng | inflation |

## Which word?

- **存款 vs 存钱 vs 省钱.** 存款 is the money you have saved. 存钱 is putting money aside. 省钱 is spending less.
- **贷款 vs 借钱 vs 欠.** 贷款 is a loan from a bank. 借钱 is borrowing from a person. 欠 is the state of owing afterwards.
- **收入 vs 工资.** 工资 is your salary. 收入 is all income, including rent or investments.
- **支出 vs 开销.** Both are spending. 支出 is the formal, bookkeeping word; 开销 is what you say over dinner.
- **押金 vs 定金.** 押金 is a refundable deposit (rent, bike). 定金 secures a purchase and you usually lose it if you back out.
- **划算 vs 便宜.** 便宜 is cheap. 划算 is good value, which can include paying more for more.

## Examples

- 买房子要先付首付,剩下的贷款。 mǎi fángzi yào xiān fù shǒufù, shèngxia de dàikuǎn: To buy a home you pay a down payment and borrow the rest
- 现在存款利息太低,不如拿去投资。 xiànzài cúnkuǎn lìxī tài dī, bùrú ná qù tóuzī: Savings interest is so low, you might as well invest
- 我们得做个预算,不能乱花钱了。 wǒmen děi zuò ge yùsuàn, bù néng luàn huā qián le: We need a budget, we can't keep spending freely
- 这次出差的发票记得留着报销。 zhè cì chūchāi de fāpiào jìde liúzhe bàoxiāo: Keep the receipts from this trip for reimbursement
- 房租又涨价了。 fángzū yòu zhǎngjià le: The rent's gone up again
- 办年卡比每次买票划算多了。 bàn niánkǎ bǐ měi cì mǎi piào huásuàn duō le: An annual pass is much better value than buying tickets each time
- 信用卡账单下周到期。 xìnyòngkǎ zhàngdān xià zhōu dàoqī: The credit card bill is due next week
- 他退休以后靠退休金生活。 tā tuìxiū yǐhòu kào tuìxiūjīn shēnghuó: Since retiring he lives on his pension
- 我上个月借给你的钱,你什么时候还? wǒ shàng ge yuè jiè gěi nǐ de qián, nǐ shénme shíhou huán: When are you paying back the money I lent you last month?

cards.Example: 我们的存款不多了。 wǒmen de cúnkuǎn bù duō le: We don't have much savings left
cards.Notes: 存钱 = to save money (verb); 存款 = the savings themselves.

cards.English: loan / to take out a loan
cards.Example: 他们贷款买了辆车。 tāmen dàikuǎn mǎi le liàng chē: They took out a loan to buy a car
cards.Notes: 贷款 is from a bank; 借钱 is borrowing from people.

cards.Example: 现在银行利息很低。 xiànzài yínháng lìxī hěn dī: Bank interest is really low right now
cards.Notes: 利率 = interest rate.

cards.Example: 他把钱都拿去投资了。 tā bǎ qián dōu ná qù tóuzī le: He put all his money into investments
我爸最近在炒股票。 wǒ bà zuìjìn zài chǎo gǔpiào: My dad's been trading stocks lately
cards.Notes: 炒股 = trade stocks (casual). 股市 = stock market.

cards.Example: 我们的预算只有五千块。 wǒmen de yùsuàn zhǐ yǒu wǔqiān kuài: Our budget is only five thousand
cards.Notes: 超预算 = over budget.

cards.Example: 这个价格含税吗? zhège jiàgé hán shuì ma: Does this price include tax?
cards.Notes: 交税 = pay tax; 报税 = file taxes; 退税 = tax refund.

cards.Example: 每个月还房贷压力很大。 měi ge yuè huán fángdài yālì hěn dà: Paying the mortgage every month is a lot of pressure
cards.Notes: 还 is huán here: 还房贷 = repay the mortgage.

cards.Example: 你买保险了吗? nǐ mǎi bǎoxiǎn le ma: Do you have insurance?
cards.Notes: 买保险 = take out insurance. 保险 also means 'safe, a sure bet'.

cards.Example: 我妈每个月有退休金。 wǒ mā měi ge yuè yǒu tuìxiūjīn: My mum gets a pension every month
cards.Notes: 养老金 is the more official term.

cards.Example: 出差的费用可以报销。 chūchāi de fèiyòng kěyǐ bàoxiāo: Business trip expenses can be claimed back
cards.Notes: 发票 (receipt / invoice) is what you need to 报销.

cards.Example: 这个月的账单还没付。 zhège yuè de zhàngdān hái méi fù: This month's bills haven't been paid yet
cards.Notes: At a restaurant you say 买单 or 结账, not 账单.

cards.Example: 他的收入还算稳定。 tā de shōurù hái suàn wěndìng: His income is fairly stable
cards.Notes: 收入 is all income; 工资 is salary only.

cards.Example: 这个月支出比收入还多。 zhège yuè zhīchū bǐ shōurù hái duō: This month we spent more than we earned
cards.Notes: Formal pair with 收入. Spoken: 开销.

cards.Example: 在大城市生活开销很大。 zài dà chéngshì shēnghuó kāixiāo hěn dà: Living in a big city is expensive
自己做饭能省不少钱。 zìjǐ zuòfàn néng shěng bù shǎo qián: Cooking for yourself saves a lot of money
cards.Notes: 省钱 = spend less; 存钱 = put money aside.

cards.Example: 别浪费时间了。 bié làngfèi shíjiān le: Stop wasting time
这么买比较划算。 zhème mǎi bǐjiào huásuàn: It's better value to buy it this way
cards.Notes: 不划算 = not worth it. 值 is similar: 值不值?

cards.Example: 最近什么都在涨价。 zuìjìn shénme dōu zài zhǎngjià: Everything's getting more expensive lately
cards.Notes: Opposite: 降价. 涨工资 = get a raise.

cards.English: to give a discount / be on sale
cards.Example: 这件衣服打八折。 zhè jiàn yīfu dǎ bā zhé: This top is 20% off
cards.Notes: 打八折 means you pay 80%, i.e. 20% off.

cards.Example: 可以刷信用卡吗? kěyǐ shuā xìnyòngkǎ ma: Can I pay by credit card?
cards.Notes: 刷卡 = swipe a card.

cards.Example: 手机我是分期买的。 shǒujī wǒ shì fēnqī mǎi de: I bought my phone in installments
cards.Notes: 分期付款 is the full form.

cards.Example: 他还欠我两千块。 tā hái qiàn wǒ liǎngqiān kuài: He still owes me two thousand
cards.Notes: 欠人情 = owe someone a favor.

cards.English: to manage one's money / personal finance
cards.Example: 年轻人也该学学理财。 niánqīngrén yě gāi xuéxue lǐcái: Young people should learn to manage money too
cards.Notes: 理财产品 = bank investment products.

cards.Example: 今天的汇率是多少? jīntiān de huìlǜ shì duōshao: What's the exchange rate today?
cards.Notes: 换钱 = change money.

cards.Example: 我直接转账给你吧。 wǒ zhíjiē zhuǎnzhàng gěi nǐ ba: I'll just transfer it to you
租房要交两个月押金。 zūfáng yào jiāo liǎng ge yuè yājīn: Renting needs two months' deposit
cards.Notes: 押金 = refundable deposit; 定金 = down payment that secures a deal.

cards.Example: 通货膨胀越来越严重了。 tōnghuò péngzhàng yuè lái yuè yánzhòng le: Inflation is getting worse and worse
cards.Notes: Shortened to 通胀 in the news.

cards.English: How much is the monthly payment?
cards.Pinyin: měi ge yuè yào huán duōshao
cards.Notes: 还 (huán) = repay.

cards.English: I'm a bit short on money this month.
cards.Pinyin: zhège yuè wǒ shǒutóu yǒudiǎn jǐn
cards.Notes: 手头紧 = short on cash; 手头宽裕 = flush.
